description: Match a messaging conversation back to a lead/contact. Provide external_chat_id (Beeper chatID, primary key) and/or handle (+optional channel). A phone number as handle is also matched like find_by_phone (incl. contact mobiles) - only a UNIQUE lead or contact is returned. Returns { lead_id, contact_id, do_not_track } or null. Run BEFORE creating records to avoid duplicates.

channel.description: Messaging channel the handle belongs to (narrows a handle match)

handle.description: Handle of the person on the channel, e.g. phone number, mail address or profile URL

name: find_lead_by_channel
